<function name="GetFogMode" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
		Returns the current fog mode.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">
			Fog mode, see <page>Enums/MATERIAL_FOG</page>.

			In 2D post-processing hooks, starting with <page>GM:PreDrawEffects</page>, this will always return <page text="MATERIAL_FOG_NONE">Enums/MATERIAL_FOG#MATERIAL_FOG_NONE</page>
		</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
